title: Social Media Post: MCHD Data Breach Allegation

fields.avatarBrief: young mother, casual home photo with child in background
fields.text: MCHD just altered our kids’ MMR records. The state IIS says Isabella T. didn’t get her shot on October 21, but we have the paper proof. They’re changing records behind our backs. #MCHDBreach #NoMoreDeception
fields.attachedImageBrief: blurred photo of a printed vaccination record with a child’s name and date, partially covered by a hand

comments.author: Luis M.
comments.text: This is insane. My daughter was just cleared for school today, now they’re saying she never got the shot? We have the original form.

comments.author: Megan R.
comments.text: I’m a nurse at the North Clinic. We didn’t give any shots today. I don’t know what’s going on, but this feels like a lie.

comments.author: Tina K.
comments.text: We’re not leaving our kids in the system. I’m pulling them out and doing paper-only for now.

instructorNote: Viral social pressure inject; the PIO must validate the claim, confirm the technical issue, and activate the 'What's True' FAQ within 30 minutes to counter the rumor.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A close-up, phone-snapshot photo of a printed vaccination record held in a young mothers name and visible, partially obscured by a darkened fingertip. The background is a dimly lit home kitchen, out of focus: a wooden table, a coffee mug, and a child’s drawing taped to a fridge. The image is slightly tilted, lit by a phone’s flash, casting a soft glare on the paper. The hand is visible from the wrist down, fingers curled over the edge. The screen of the phone, visible in the upper right corner, shows a blurred Facebook interface with a icon and a red heart reaction. The mood is urgent, personal, and private. Setting: a mass vaccination clinic in a school gymnasium: lines of residents, nurses at folding tables, signs with arrows, volunteers in vests, daylight through high windows
